scientific_integrity: The classical inequality \(\lambda_2\le\sigma/\sqrt3\), the identity \(\lambda_2=G/2\), and Papadatos's discrete-uniform order-statistic result are treated as prior. The claimed contribution is only the sharp mass-sensitive refinement, its fixed-mass equality geometry, and the resulting sharp atom-count envelope. A specific residual literature risk from the inaccessible 2006 empirical-Gini full text is disclosed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is finite-atomic and assumes positive masses and nonzero finite variance. It does not cover continuous-discrete mixtures, countably infinite support, higher L-moments, or order-statistic correlations.
title: Sharp mass-sensitive finite-atomic Gini–variance bound
